it.txt: Era vice-prefeito e tomou posse como prefeito em 02/04/2026, em sessão solene na Câmara Municipal, depois que Cristiano Gerardão renunciou ao cargo para concorrer a deputado federal na eleição de 2026.
it.txt_en: He was vice mayor and was sworn in as mayor on April 2, 2026, in a formal session at the City Council, after Mayor Cristiano Gerardão resigned to run for federal deputy in the 2026 election.
